stage0051b_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Nothing seems wrong with $l, desu.
　It's probably just exhaustion, desu.」

stage0051b_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$アルト$$
「No wonder...
　The man they had been chasing just showed up right in front of them」

stage0051b_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$甲児$$
「To think he was behind the whole war,
　and on top of that, trying to stop time in this world...」

stage0051b_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$宗介$$
「...That man, $$ガドライト$$...
　just how much power does he have...」

stage0051b_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$カレン$$
「We've fought terrifying foes like 《$$アイム$$》
　and Prince 《$$ユーサー$$》, or 《$$ガイオウ$$》,
　but this one is an entirely different breed...」

stage0051b_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But that man made the biggest mistake of all」

stage0051b_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It was probably just a half-hearted taunt,
　but that man showed himself before us」

stage0051b_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If we had kept running until the three months
　he spoke of had passed, we might have faced
　that $$エタニティ・フラット$$ with no countermeasure at all」

stage0051b_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カレン$$
「So if we corner him,
　we'll find out what to do about it!」

stage0051b_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「At the very least, I'd call that
　far more constructive than wallowing in despair」

stage0051b_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$宗介$$
「As expected of a negotiator.
　Quite the smooth talker」

stage0051b_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$, you jerk!
　He's just trying to encourage us,
　that's why he's saying it!」

stage0051b_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Don't mind it, miss.
　My role was only to offer a small nudge」

stage0051b_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「How one takes that is up to each person」

stage0051b_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$宗介$$
「So you're saying anyone still pessimistic
　is a cowardly good-for-nothing?」

stage0051b_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see, Sergeant $$相良宗介$$.
　You seem to be quite the positive man」

stage0051b_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「You're confident you're not
　that cowardly good-for-nothing, aren't you?」

stage0051b_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Affirmative.
　Once a method is given, carrying it out
　with full effort is a soldier's duty」

stage0051b_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Understood, Sergeant.
　I think you and I will get along well」

stage0051b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「If that's the case, it shows exactly what kind of man he is」

stage0051b_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Don't let it bother you.
　She... $$Ｒ．ドロシー・ウェインライト$$, being a robot,
　tends to be a bit blunt in her manner」

stage0051b_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hah...
　Same with $$モーム$$, they look just like a human」

stage0051b_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「I've decided to come along with you all too.
　Nice to work with you」

stage0051b_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「But I don't intend to pilot the $$ビッグオー$$」

stage0051b_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Understood, $$ドロシー#240$$.
　That was never really your job to begin with」

stage0051b_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「Then what about your job?
　Does this $c have a place for you?」

stage0051b_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The answer is yes.
　Negotiating with this world's absurdities
　and guiding them right, that is my mission」

stage0051b_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That is the job I, the negotiator
　$$ロジャー・スミス$$, have taken on」

stage0051b_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「Who asked that of you?」

stage0051b_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Someone at the bottom of my memory」

stage0051b_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「An excuse to hide your true feelings?
　Still as stubborn as ever」

stage0051b_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That you can only take it that way
　says quite a bit about you too」

stage0051b_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「It seems I've spent
　far too long around you」

stage0051b_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$カレン$$
「Glad for you, $$ドロシー#240$$.
　$$ロジャー$$'s memory came back」

stage0051b_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah.
　If he'd stayed homeless, exchanges like this
　wouldn't have been possible」

stage0051b_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$Ｒ．ドロシー・ウェインライト$$.
　I'm grateful to you for giving me the chance
　to recover my memory」

stage0051b_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「It's been quite a while, it seems,
　since I last heard words like that」

stage0051b_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even your sarcasm still sounds fresh to me today」

stage0051b_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$甲児$$
「The captains' meeting should wrap up soon.
　...Though our destination's probably already decided」

stage0051b_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アルト$$
「The coordinates $$アドヴェント$$ gave us...
　What's waiting there...」

stage0051b_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「One who watches over humanity's evolution...
　$$アドヴェント$$, was it...」

stage0051b_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Then, Master $$ロジャー$$...
　as preparation for heading into space,
　I'd like to have your coat cleaned first」

stage0051b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Wait a moment, $$ノーマン$$.
　Let me empty my pockets first」

stage0051b_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「What is it, $$ロジャー$$?」

stage0051b_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A slip of paper in my pocket... some kind of note...?」

stage0051b_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$アムロ$$... the analysis of the machine
　you requested is complete」

stage0051b_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Both the $$ジェガン$$ and $$ギラ・ドーガ$$ that appeared
　in Paradigm City were genuine, not replicas of any kind」

stage0051b_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Also, as a trait shared by both,
　we found scorch marks consistent with atmospheric reentry」

stage0051b_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's odd.
　For one, neither of those two machines
　has the ability to reenter the atmosphere alone」

stage0051b_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then perhaps they were forced into the atmosphere,
　and something shielded them from burning up...」

stage0051b_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$.
　You went to the trouble of checking, but it seems
　this won't be much of a lead after all」

stage0051b_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no... I'm usually just an idle freeloader,
　so I'm happy just to be relied on like this」

stage0051b_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I see...
　Well, if anything comes up, I'll ask you again」

stage0051b_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no... Master $$アムロ$$.
　This investigation was worth my while too」

stage0051b_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$アムロ$$'s unease and doubt
　earned us 50Z worth of fine Z-Chips.
　I'll add these to the squad's stock, too」

stage0051b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$.
　I look forward to working with you」

stage0051b_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Oh? Did I do something to earn your dislike?」

stage0051b_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No...
　It's just, when I think about talking with you
　and having my words twisted...」

stage0051b_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll have you know, D-Trader doesn't negotiate
　discounts, not one bit...!」

stage0051b_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And another thing,
　this $$ＡＧ$$ won't cave to violence either!
　Bring an arrow or the $$ビッグオー$$ itself, I don't care!」

stage0051b_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see.
　Your passion for the job exceeds what I'd heard」

stage0051b_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「To a professional like that...
　no, a robot, I'll offer my respect too」

stage0051b_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of a negotiator!
　Quite the smooth talker!」

stage0051b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Buttering me up to angle for a discount?
　Not gonna fly, not across dimensions,
　honestly!」

stage0051b_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I'm not getting carried away
　just because you praised me!
　Really! This is really true!」

stage0051b_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Understood, $$ＡＧ$$.
　Then, let me take a look at your prized D-Trader」

stage0051b_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood!
　As a fellow professional, allow me to show
　Master $$ロジャー$$ the treasured goods I've stocked!」

stage0051b_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then!
　Today I'll work extra hard... business, business!」
